title: Workout Timing is Deceptive
review: This app will get 5 stars when they list the workout timing correctly. For instance, it lists the workout for 12 minutes, but it takes 18 minutes because they didn't calculate the 'rest' time. I find this annoying as often I like to do an extra workout, because I enjoy them, but have to plan extra time to do it. I cannot just pick one when I have a spare 10 minutes since it takes 15 minutes to do all the exercises in the workout episode. Please fix this.
author: Samssan

title: Great app but…
review: I'm really enjoying this app but unfortunately I downloaded it to my phone when I subscribed. There's no way to download to another device or cast it to a tv. Very frustrating. Also some of the verbal guidance doesn't match what's shown on the video. For example, when the video is showing the avatar touching their knee, the verbal instructions say to touch your ankle. It's only a 10 minute workout, but I really feel like I had a good stretch and I think it's made a difference in my balance
author: Seabird7

title: Finally
review: I have looked at several Tai Chi exercise programs. I'm immediately turned off when the price shows a big discount but the then it's terribly expensive. How can you trust when deceived at the beginning. I'm on day two of free trial. No cc info asked for. It fits my age and ability. The price for a year is reasonable. I'm excited for this adventure.
author: Ninnix3

title: Great app
review: I use this app as a cool down after working out. I feel it helps me relax while enhancing my flexibility and balance. I would like to see the ability to use the app offline so that when I am traveling I can use the app if I don't have internet access. I really missed it on my last trip. Thanks
author: Jombokin

title: No password reset link
review: Love this app and its workouts. My only complaint is that there is no password reset link. I had to reset my devices and lost my password. I no longer can access my account without sending an email to support. This is the only app/website that I know that doesn't have this way of recovering your account.
author: merrilles

title: Enjoying this very much
review: I'm not losing any weight BUT my whole body feels so much better. I got sick and for 5 days I couldn't exercise and I felt the difference. These exercises help my whole body feel healthier, more balanced, and my friends are noticing that I look better even though I'm not losing weight. TRY THIS APP. It's not expensive and it's worthwhile.
author: 13Jasons

title: Awakening
review: Update: I've been using this app for 8 months and do enjoy it. I honestly believe it wakes my body up for the day. But, the app has limitations. The workouts regenerate every 28 days and you restart at a beginners level, so the app does not progress with you. The app also has glitches such as repeating the same exercise within a daily workout. For these reasons, I lowered my rating from 5 to 4. Original review: I am 63 and starting to feel stiff. I work full time but also have a small farm with horses, goats, and chickens. I weighed Tai Chi. Resist yoga, and decided to try the Tai Chi because it offers more movement. After 24 days and counting, I couldn't be happier. I do the workouts every morning before my shower and I definitely feel invigorated and awakened for the day. Extremely happy with the results and am now a lifelong Tai Chi fan!
author: Metoodo

title: Love this app
review: This is my first time to try tai chi. I am 66 and in reasonably good shape. I walk every day and go to the gym for cardio and weight training three times a week. But these workouts still raise my heart rate by around 20 beats per minute. They are also easy on my chronic plantar fasciitis.Update: My main complaint is that specific exercises have begun to repeat themselves. I got the same routine three times in a row. During the same session two other exercises also repeated themselves. But they only appeared twice.
author: Icbihthak

title: Tai Chi for Seniors Awesome!
review: The only thing I didn't like and didn't know is once you do the exercise is you can't see it after the first time you do it . I watched how they did the first day and then I was going to do the exercise, but, I couldn't bring it up again. That's the only thing I was disappointed about. It seems easy enough to do but I couldn't remember the first day moves. Other than that… I Love It! I can't subscribe to it because I don't have a credit or debit card, so I can only do the free part. Awesome app!
author: Sandy Ridge, NC FAN

title: Rejuvenating
review: I can say with confidence that after my first time going through the exercises of my personally designed plan, my body already can feel it.. in GOOD way too. My back and spine feel loose and relaxed. I felt this the most with the crane movement. My shoulder also are so much looser and relaxed. I'm 41 and I do a lot of standing on one spot and I use my wrists and shoulders a lot at work so they are always tight and soar. After one run through this program of exercises I feel AMAZING!! Highly recommend!!
author: You can call me Asj
